item.title: McDougall Energy acquires Cochrane-based fuel, logistics companies
item.description: Sault Ste. Marie–based McDougall Energy has expanded its Northern Ontario footprint with the acquisition of two Cochrane companies. McDougall Energy Inc. and McDougall Transportation Inc. finalized the purchase of Meridian Fuels and Northern Freight & Logistics on Feb. 10. The deal brings the family-owned businesses under the McDougall banner, adding fuel distribution and freight services […]
